section1.title: Health is an inherent right of every person
section1.desc: Health should not be a privilege for the few, nor merely a remedy after illness. Every life deserves to live, grow, and age in health.

section2.desc: We live in an unprecedented era—with more advanced medicine, technology, and health information than ever before. Yet more people are still troubled by chronic illness, stress, anxiety, sleep issues, and lifestyle imbalance. What we may truly lack is not more treatment, but a new view of health, a new way of living, and a new civilization—what we call: Health Civilization.

section5.title: Discovery Journey
section5.desc:
This is not a trip—it is a rediscovery of yourself.
From body and emotion to life rhythm, every step is gently held.
Between nature, medicine, and inner awareness, find your own health cadence.
Begin your Discovery Journey.

airport-pickup.title: Arrival Pickup · Someone Is Waiting for You
airport-pickup.desc: Your dedicated driver will wait in the arrivals hall 30 minutes before landing with a name sign. Before departure, we send the driver's photo, name, and license plate so you can verify every detail. Your Toyota Alphard is spacious, with room reserved for your luggage. If a flight is delayed, we monitor it and adjust the pickup automatically.

welcome.title: Welcome Home · Arrive and Settle In
welcome.desc: A private welcome ritual, a warm greeting, a freshly prepared welcome drink, and tropical fruit. Dietary needs can be noted in advance, and the same welcome is reserved for late-night arrivals.

check-in.title: Healing Villa · Your Private Space to Rest
check-in.desc: Before you arrive, the villa is aired and deeply cleaned: linens and glassware are heat-sanitized. A private garden, independent door lock, and 24-hour security let you rest without concern. Concierge support is available whenever needed, without intrusion.

spa.title: Healing Spa · Professional Care, Complete Ease
spa.desc: Licensed therapists, freshly changed linens and towels, and a room reserved only for you. One gesture adjusts the pressure, and you may request a therapist's gender in advance. Here, every detail is yours to decide.

kitchen.title: Longevity Lunch · A Shared Kitchen
kitchen.desc: No cooking experience is needed. The chef guides you from preparation to plating, while heat and seasoning are thoughtfully managed. You simply enjoy making something with your hands.

health-assessment.title: Life Assessment · Knowing You to Care for You Better
health-assessment.desc: After arrival, your dedicated health advisor takes about 30 minutes to understand your personal journey baseline in private. The findings are used only to tailor meals and activities, and only you can see the data.

afternoon-tea.title: Meet Hera · Tea, a Story, and a Personal Postcard
afternoon-tea.desc: At afternoon tea, HERAVITA's founder welcomes you in the garden tea room. Learn why this place was chosen and where HERAVITA's vision began. Before entrusting your body and mind to a place, meet the person who protects it—and send that sense of ease home.

float-therapy.title: Floating Healing · The Water Holds You, We Stay With You
float-therapy.desc: A soft floating mat holds you steadily on the water. Sunlight filters through your lashes, a breeze moves past your ears, and the pool rocks gently like a childhood cradle. Someone stays nearby as the world becomes sky, water, and a body growing lighter.

sunset.title: Sunset Pool Gathering · The Softest Moment of the Day
sunset.desc: At sunset, the poolside quietly changes: lights and candles glow, gentle music unfolds, and chilled welcome drinks and small bites await. Raise a glass with another guest, or give yourself fully to a lounge chair. Here, company and solitude need no explanation.

party.title: Welcome Dinner · Your First Meal of Arrival
party.desc: After sunset, gather at a candlelit garden table in relaxed resort wear. The chef designs the menu for a body after flying: gentle, light, easy to digest, with seasonal local flavors and familiar international comfort dishes.

evening-meditation.title: Evening Meditation
evening-meditation.desc: At the end of the day, slow the breath and realign body and mind.

morning-practice.title: Morning Practice
morning-practice.desc: Awaken with gentle movement and awareness to begin an energized day.

nature-walk.title: Nature Walk
nature-walk.desc: Step into light and wind, and let nature reset your rhythm.

ucla.title: UCLA Health · USA
ucla.desc: UCLA Health is one of the most comprehensive and advanced healthcare systems in the world.

sedona.title: Sedona Healing Center · USA
sedona.desc: A sanctuary for spiritual healing and the awakening of body, mind, and spirit. Sedona’s Energy Vortexes concentrate the Earth’s natural energy—ideal for meditation, emotional release, and physical restoration.

scn.title: Stem Cell Network (SCN) · Canada
scn.desc: Canada’s national stem-cell and regenerative-medicine platform, founded in 2001 with federal support. It has invested over CAD 100 million, backing 200+ research projects and 30+ clinical trials.

milan.title: Milan Castle Health Lab · Italy
milan.desc: In a centuries-old castle in Milan, HERAVITA has created a health laboratory across eras—bringing functional medicine, biotechnology, and Eastern wellness philosophy into a historic setting of graceful longevity.

paris.title: Paris Medical Referral Network · France
paris.desc: Through the Paris medical referral network, HERAVITA builds a bridge to Europe’s leading specialists—offering a full path from precise testing to in-depth care, and truly global one-to-one medicine.

laprairie.title: Clinique La Prairie · Switzerland
laprairie.desc: Founded in 1931 on Lake Geneva in Montreux, it is a pioneer of modern longevity medicine. Dr. Paul Niehans first proposed Cellular Therapy—restoring vitality by tending to the body’s cells.

peptide.title: Peptide Therapy Lab · Switzerland
peptide.desc: Peptide therapy supplements the body’s natural active peptides to activate cells, repair tissue, slow aging, and regulate immunity—messengers that start repair, metabolism, sleep, and hormonal balance.

harley.title: The Harley Street Clinic · UK
harley.desc: Part of HCA, The Harley Street Clinic is known for advanced equipment and nursing, with particular strength in oncology research, breast-cancer chemotherapy, and pediatric cardiac surgery.

imperial.title: Imperial College Healthcare · UK
imperial.desc: Uniting five leading London hospitals with Imperial College London, it is a model of research translation and clinical practice, home to an NIHR Biomedical Research Centre and a partner in the 100,000 Genomes Project.

tokyo.title: The University of Tokyo Hospital · Japan
tokyo.desc: One of Japan’s most authoritative medical institutions, leading in complex and critical care—especially oncology, cardiovascular disease, and regenerative medicine. HERAVITA partners for expert consults, international checkups, and referrals.

regen.title: Japan Regenerative Medicine Center · Japan
regen.desc: A leading cell-therapy institution focused on stem cells, immune cells, and regenerative medicine—mature, safe, and strong in anti-aging, chronic-condition care, and tissue repair.

kyoto.title: Kyoto Mind-Body Clinic · Japan
kyoto.desc: Integrating modern psychiatry with Eastern therapies such as acupuncture and massage, it supports whole-person balance for stress, anxiety, and depression in a calm, elegant setting.

bumrungrad.title: Bumrungrad International Hospital · Thailand
bumrungrad.desc: A leading international hospital in Southeast Asia, known for advanced care and a complete service system—especially precision medicine and personalized health management, connecting treatment with environmental healing.

bangkok.title: Bangkok Hospital · Thailand
bangkok.desc: One of the most influential private hospitals in Thailand and Asia, known for international care and an outstanding patient experience across cardiology, oncology, neurology, and more.

chiangmai.title: Chiang Mai Health Center · Thailand
chiangmai.desc: In northern Thailand’s cultural capital, it blends modern medicine with natural therapies—detox, nutrition, yoga, and meditation—in a quiet setting for whole-person restoration.
